sky.prompt: Midnight synthwave panorama: deep indigo-to-black gradient, scattered stars, a faint pink aurora haze on the horizon and a distant neon city skyline silhouette with glowing pink and cyan window strips.

icon_gem.prompt: A faceted energy-core gem icon, glowing cyan with hot pink inner light, sharp angular cut, dark background

icon_clock.prompt: A slim digital countdown clock icon with neon cyan digits and a pink ring, dark background

icon_heart.prompt: A hexagonal energy-heart icon in hot neon pink with a cyan outline glow, dark background

icon_skull.prompt: A spiky orb skull icon — a round spiked ball with glowing cyan eye sockets, dark background

music_main.prompt: Synthwave / retrowave loop: driving 8th-note arpeggio bass, gated snare, punchy kick, shimmering neon pads, 118 BPM, high-energy nocturnal drive.

sfx_collect.prompt: Bright rising arpeggio blip with a glassy synth chime, like banking a charged core

sfx_boost.prompt: Electric whoosh with a fast rising pitch, synth dash burst

sfx_hit.prompt: Gritty distorted thud with a short metallic ring, punchy hit

sfx_death.prompt: Power-down sweep: descending synth glide with crackling static tail

sfx_win.prompt: Triumphant synthwave riser landing on a bright chord stab

sfx_lose.prompt: Low detuned drone with a sad synthwave hit, fading to static
